topics.name: component quality
topics.description: The physical production: cards, miniatures, boards, tokens, dice and the box insert.

topics.name: rules and learning curve
topics.description: How easy the game is to learn and teach: rulebook clarity, player aids and first-game confusion.

topics.name: difficulty and balance
topics.description: How hard the game is to win, how much luck decides outcomes and whether the heroes are evenly matched.

topics.name: art and graphic design
topics.description: Illustrations, iconography and how readable the text and symbols are.

topics.name: replayability and variety
topics.description: How much variety the scenarios, events and heroes offer over many plays.

topics.name: setup and play time
topics.description: How long setup, teardown and a full game take.

topics.name: theme and story
topics.description: The setting, narrative and how strongly the game makes players feel part of its world.

topics.name: player count scaling
topics.description: How the game changes between two, three, four or more players at the table.

topics.name: solo play
topics.description: Playing the game alone, including the one-player rules and how well they work.

topics.name: component quality
topics.description: Physical production quality of miniatures, cards, boards, tokens, dice and other parts, including defects, damage and durability.

topics.name: rulebook and learning curve
topics.description: How clear or confusing the rulebook, teaching materials and player aids are, and how easy the game is to learn and teach.

topics.name: setup storage and time
topics.description: Effort of setup, teardown, box insert, storage and table space, plus how long sessions and rounds take compared with the stated time and whether the pace suits players.

topics.name: artwork and readability
topics.description: Quality of illustration and visual style, plus legibility of icons, fonts, text and colours.

topics.name: difficulty and balance
topics.description: Challenge level, luck versus skill, fairness of losses, difficulty settings and balance between heroes.

topics.name: replayability and variety
topics.description: Whether scenarios, events, heroes and campaign branches stay fresh over many plays or become repetitive.

topics.name: player count scaling
topics.description: How well the game performs at different numbers of players, from two to five.

topics.name: theme and story
topics.description: How well the setting, narrative text, lore and world-building come through in play and engage the players.

topics.name: price crowdfunding and shipping
topics.description: Value for money, retail versus pledge pricing, crowdfunding delivery, shipping costs, editions and availability.

topics.name: solo play
topics.description: Experience of playing alone, including the solo mode, variants, scoring and automa quality.

method.providerLabel: Two-phase topics (Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 (topic-discovery-v2) → consolidation (topic-consolidation-v3) + TypeSafe jev-latest (jev-topic-a1), batches of ≤ 25)

topics.definition: How clear or confusing the rulebook, teaching materials and player aids are, and how easy the game is to learn and teach.

topics.name: Component Quality
topics.definition: Physical production quality of miniatures, cards, boards, tokens, dice and other parts, including defects, damage and durability.

topics.definition: How long sessions, rounds and setup-plus-play take compared with the stated time, and whether the pace suits the players.

topics.name: Replayability and Variety

topics.name: Difficulty and Balance
